name: rosetta-find-common-directory-path
code:
use default

common_directory_path(paths: string[]) -> string is
    let segments = paths |> map(p => p.split(['/'])) |> collect_array()
    let common = LIST[string]()

    for i in 0..segments[0].count do
        let candidate = segments[0][i]

        if segments |> all(s => i < s.count /\ s[i] =~ candidate) then
            common.add(candidate)
        else
            break
        fi
    od

    common |> join("/")
si

let paths = [
    "/home/user1/tmp/coverage/test",
    "/home/user1/tmp/covert/operator",
    "/home/user1/tmp/coven/members"
]

write_line(common_directory_path(paths))
